items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: have you ever heard of a guy named Elmer Scobel?

ctx.x: No, that was different, that was a gig with a, it was a dance band, I was working at the Waltz Dream - did I say Waltz Dream before? - yeah, Waltz Dream, it was a dancing hall for negroes. Lot of people would be there, see - I think it was three times a week or something like that. And we had music - see, you could buy, you could buy stock arrangements, that's when the birth of stock arrangements, you know. And you also buy semi-swing things, you know, little things by guys like, have you ever heard of a guy…
Schoebel, I got the wrong name, yeah.
